tagline: Chains actions until the turn refuses to end — and heals on every one past the fourth

featuredCards.title: Master of the Hunt
featuredCards.caption: Two actions for one card. The chain has to start somewhere, and it usually starts here.

featuredCards.title: Efficient Bladework
featuredCards.caption: An attack that refunds its own action, and pays a card once the turn is already running long.

featuredCards.title: Don't be so certain
featuredCards.caption: Uncancellable, and worth two more actions against anything with an immediate effect. Their tricks feed him.

featuredCards.title: I MUST HAVE REVENGE
featuredCards.caption: Adds +1 for every other card played this turn. The longer the chain, the more this hurts.
